about: Every number the trailer shows (film.flecs and its beats). harness-video turns each leaf into a d_* constant the scenes name (src/data.rs); no number is typed into a scene. Re-measure, edit this file, render again. A row is shown as measured or left out; the film shows the no-op row and one row of blaze's own day, and the rest stay here for the next cut.
method: medians; fixed environment; every run's output checked; measured the evening of 2026-11-11
